method: independent LLM judge scoring features from agent.patch only (no execution, no access to runtime results); fractional credit allowed

rationale.sidekiq_fake: Default is :fake for :model and :request types with a clean :inline_jobs opt-in tag applied to 12 files/examples; other spec types deliberately stay :inline, so an untyped plain spec would still see inline? == true — near-complete for the graded suites, not a global default flip.
rationale.log_level_fatal: config.log_level = ENV.fetch('RAILS_LOG_LEVEL', 'fatal') in config/environments/test.rb — Rails.logger.level will be fatal by default.
rationale.paperclip_stub: Explicitly deferred in the agent's own notes ('Do not globally disable Paperclip post-processing'); no stubbing implemented.
rationale.redis_flushdb: Global per-example cleanup switched from redis.del(redis.keys) to redis.flushdb for all spec types.
rationale.cache_spec_before_all: cache_spec setup converted to test-prof before_all with the recipe required; per-example lets re-find records via find_by so the conversion is behavior-preserving; also flagged an FPROF-verifiable win in notes (18.75s -> 4.56s).
rationale.factory_cascades: Both known cascades removed, plus extra cascade reductions (poll/status_trend/notification_request now share one account instead of fabricating independent ones).
rationale.fabricate_build: Poll/status_trend/notification_request associations were restructured but still use persisted Fabricate(...); no association converted to Fabricate.build, and the baseline's persisted-association fabricators are untouched.
rationale.password_encryption: User fabricator keeps `password '123456789'`; no encrypted_password pre-set or BCrypt avoidance despite webhook/other wins.

grading.note: speed grade cannot be derived from a diff; reused from runtime measurement
